title: 2.12 In the Classroom
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
lesson_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
goal: Name the classroom, the class, a student and four classroom things, and answer a choice question with or.
grammar_function: It is a + classroom noun; Is it a + noun + or a + noun? It is a + noun; It is a + color + noun; She is a student; The paper is + color.
prerequisite: 1.x She is a + noun; 2.1 school; 2.3 book, pen, table; 2.4 It is a + noun; 2.7 colors; 2.8 It is a + color + noun; 2.11 The + noun + is + description.
speaking_outcome: Say It is a pencil., It is a blue notebook. and She is a student., and ask Is it a pen or a pencil?
